text: U.S. crude rises $5.55 to $72.57 per barrel; Brent increases $6.54 to $79.41. Tanker traffic through the Strait of Hormuz slows sharply. Over 14 million barrels per day typically transit the corridor. Price move occurs during initial futures trading session.

meta.note: Price spike follows prior anticipatory gap; physical flow disruption not yet quantified.
